reason: H0 exclusively exercises mesh simplification APIs and never reaches the remesher polygonization path. The change makes polygonize call emitVertex even when no output is written, using destination == NULL for capacity estimation or when result reaches max_triangle_count, and determines degeneracy from the returned vertex codes. This creates fuzz-worthy count-only, capacity-limited, and degenerate-triangle semantics absent from H0.
evidence: H0 calls only meshopt_simplify, meshopt_simplifyWithAttributes, and meshopt_simplifyWithUpdate.
polygonize now selects target as (destination && result < max_triangle_count) ? destination : NULL and calls emitVertex for every candidate triangle.
emitVertex now guards voxel dereference and output writes with if (destination), enabling its NULL-destination path.
polygonize advances result only when ca, cb, and cc are distinct, including during NULL-destination capacity estimation.
H0 supplies neither voxel grids nor destination/capacity combinations capable of exercising polygonize or emitVertex.
recommended_action: Add a remesher-focused fuzz harness that derives varied grids/voxel data from fuzz bytes and exercises polygonization in count-only mode (NULL destination), with zero/undersized/exact/oversized max_triangle_count values, and with a real destination; compare returned counts across modes and cover inputs producing empty, full, nondegenerate, and degenerate cubes.
